requirements.candidate_label: Left-lane closure channelization on both boundaries
requirements.subject: channelizing devices for the closed left lane
requirements.threshold: both the roadway center line and the adjacent lane
applicability_conditions: one lane is closed
the closed lane is the left lane
roadway is undivided
requirements.source_span: When only the left-hand lane is closed on undivided roads, channelizing devices shall be placed along the center line as well as along the adjacent lane.

requirements.candidate_label: Transition area present for stationary lane closure
requirements.subject: transition area
applicability_conditions: a lane is closed on a multilane road
operation is not mobile
required_inputs: field observation of the closure transition
requirements.source_span: When a lane is closed on a multi-lane road for other than a mobile operation, a transition area containing a merging taper shall be used.

requirements.candidate_label: Lane Closed sign for the left-lane closure
requirements.subject: advance warning signing
requirements.threshold: a Lane Closed sign with the legend LEFT LANE CLOSED
applicability_conditions: one through lane of a multilane roadway is closed
the closed lane is the left lane
required_inputs: field observation of advance warning signs and legends
requirements.source_span: The Lane(s) Closed sign (see Figure 6H-1) shall be used in advance of that point where one or more through lanes of a multi-lane roadway are closed.

requirements.candidate_label: Advance warning sign spacing for low-speed urban TA-30
requirements.subject: successive advance warning signs
requirements.threshold: 100 ft for each A, B, and C interval
applicability_conditions: TA-30 is the selected layout
the roadway is treated as an urban low-speed context
a series of advance warning signs is used
required_inputs: field measurements of A, B, and C sign separations
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-1. Recommended Advance Warning Sign Minimum Spacing. Urban (low speed): 100 feet, 100 feet, 100 feet. Urban (high speed): 350 feet, 350 feet, 350 feet. Rural: 500 feet, 500 feet, 500 feet. Expressway / Freeway: 1,000 feet, 1,500 feet, 2,640 feet. The column headings A, B, and C are the dimensions shown in Figures 6P-1 through 6P-54.

measurement_spec.quantity: A, B, and C separations between successive advance warning signs

thresholds.condition: each A, B, or C interval

requirements.subject: channelizing devices
requirements.threshold: 30 ft in taper channelization and 60 ft in tangent channelization
applicability_conditions: channelizing devices are used in the lane-closure TTC zone
posted speed is 30 mph
required_inputs: device locations classified as taper or tangent
requirements.source_span: The spacing between cones, tubular markers, vertical panels, drums, and barricades should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 1 times the speed limit in mph when used for taper channelization, and should not exceed a distance in feet equal to 2 times the speed limit in mph when used for tangent channelization.

measurement_spec.quantity: maximum spacing between successive channelizing devices by segment type

requirements.subject: channelizing devices
requirements.threshold: serviceable, and should be clean, visible, and properly positioned
applicability_conditions: channelizing devices are deployed in the TTC zone
required_inputs: visual inspection of every deployed channelizing device
requirements.source_span: Channelizing devices that are no longer serviceable (see definition in Section 1C.02) shall be replaced.

requirements.subject: merging taper
requirements.threshold: L = W S² / 60 for speeds 40 mph or less
applicability_conditions: stationary multilane lane closure uses a merging taper
posted speed is 30 mph
requirements.source_span: The appropriate taper length (L) should 60 be determined using the criteria shown in 45 mph or more L = WS Tables 6B-3 and 6B-4. Where: L = taper length in feet Support: W = width of offset in feet A merging taper requires the longest distance S = posted speed limit, or off‑peak 85th‑percentile speed

requirements.subject: downstream taper
applicability_conditions: a downstream taper is used in the TTC zone
required_inputs: field determination that a downstream taper is used
requirements.source_span: If used, a downstream taper should have a minimum length of 50 feet and a maximum length of 100 feet with devices placed at a spacing of approximately 20 feet.

requirements.subject: deployed arrow board
requirements.relation: shall be used only to indicate
requirements.threshold: a lane closure, not a lane shift
applicability_conditions: an arrow board is deployed
the work zone is a lane closure
required_inputs: arrow-board display mode and directional indication
field observation of the TTC application
requirements.source_span: Arrow boards shall only be used to indicate a lane closure. Arrow boards shall not be used to indicate a lane shift.

requirements.subject: arrow board for the stationary lane closure
requirements.threshold: on the shoulder at the beginning of the merging taper
applicability_conditions: an arrow board is deployed
the operation is a stationary lane closure
required_inputs: arrow-board location relative to the shoulder and merging-taper start
requirements.source_span: For a stationary lane closure, the arrow board should be located on the shoulder at the beginning of the merging taper.
